name: DeMomentSomTres No Shipping Message
author: Marc Queralt i Bassa

sections.description:
With this extension you can configure the message that appears when no shipping methods are available.

By default, customers see the message “No shipping methods are available…” when there are no shipping options.

This extension allows you to configure the message displayed in HTML and is prepared to be translated into multiple languages using WordPress’s native translation system.

Features:
* Simple configuration via WordPress Settings API
* Full translation support (Catalan, Spanish, English included)
* Native dependency verification (no external libraries)
* Compatible with latest versions of WordPress and WooCommerce
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/dms3-no-shipping/ folder
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure the message from ‘Settings’ > ‘No Shipping Message’

Requirements:
* WooCommerce active
sections.faq:
How to configure the message?

Go to ‘Settings’ > ‘No Shipping Message’ in your WordPress dashboard.

Is it translated?

Yes, it includes translations in Catalan, Spanish and English. The plugin automatically detects the WordPress language.
